summary: 2026 FIA WEC, #33 yellow Corvette Z06 GT3.R run by TF Sport in LMGT3 (drivers Ben Keating, Jonny Edgar, Nicky Catsburg). The team has no title sponsor: the team name carries no sponsor. Keating Chevrolet (driver Ben Keating's Texas dealership group) is on the doors and Wynn's continues its partnership on the car; both are recorded as partners because car-body placements do not map onto shirt placements. The club's partners page adds Artisan Coffee, HRX, AP Racing, Pagid Racing, AO Racing and CCM/Caseliner (team-wide, not tied to one car). Not complete: the 2026 launch renders also show Rain-X, MaxConnect Digital, Client Command and Heel Tread decals, plus series and manufacturer branding (Goodyear, DHL, Corvette), with no text source naming them.
